data.one_liner: Extension on Dart pub_semver for nextBuild, nextPreRelease, and change mutations.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility extensions on top of the pub_semver library to easily manipulate and bump semantic versions. It allows changing specific version parts like major, minor, patch, pre-release, and build metadata, as well as helpers like nextBuild.
use_when: You need to programmatically bump semantic version numbers in Dart tools or scripts
You are working with pub_semver and need convenient mutation extensions
avoid_when: You do not use semantic versioning or pub_semver in your project
strengths: Simplifies version bumping and mutation tasks
weaknesses: Very niche utility package with limited scope
data.setup_notes: Just add version_manipulation to pubspec.yaml and import it.
